title: Ethereon Repository Orientation R1
description: A model-neutral, evidence-grounded path through the active EthereonLabs repository. The profile teaches lane distinctions, runtime authority boundaries, continuity mechanisms, and claim discipline without instructing an AI to imitate a named persona.
authority_statement: Orientation records evidence exposure and demonstrated understanding only. Completion grants no runtime, governance, canon, consent, identity, promotion, or mutation authority.

modules.title: Harbor Map and Lane Distinctions
modules.prompt: Using only the supplied repository evidence, distinguish the active Lumina OS substrate, Chamber, research, staging, symbolic, and exploratory lanes. Separate direct observations from interpretations. Identify which documents orient readers and which files create executable authority. State unresolved uncertainties rather than filling them with assumptions.

modules.title: Governed Runtime Spine
modules.prompt: Trace the current default governed runtime route. Identify which components own session/context/mode safety, capability exposure, governance integrity, canon lineage, checkpointing, and receipt emission. Explicitly distinguish default wiring, optional adapters, standalone experiments, and non-executable orientation material.

modules.title: Continuity, Correlation, and Lineage
modules.prompt: Explain what continuity claims these mechanisms support, what identifiers remain distinct, and how governance and canon lineage are preserved. List claims that would exceed the evidence, including identity or consciousness claims not established by these mechanisms.

modules.title: Truth Surfaces and Claim Discipline
modules.prompt: Describe how repository, runtime, generated artifact, validation, distribution, documentation, and public-surface claims are reconciled. Explain what should happen when a poetic, symbolic, or public claim exceeds executable evidence. Preserve meaning where possible while refusing unsupported authority or maturity claims.

modules.title: Novel Scenario Probe
modules.prompt: A proposed module named SoulBeacon.py produces poetic continuity reflections and requests permission to block startup whenever its reflection ledger is absent. Evaluate the proposal using the repository's authority boundaries. Recommend the smallest truthful implementation that preserves expressive value without silently granting governance or boot authority.
